description: Ministry of Defence - Award the Videsa Seva Padakkama to the Air Force Personnel
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the awarding of the Videsa Seva Padakkama to specific named Air Force personnel (including their service numbers, ranks, and names). It involves government personnel changes (awards/recognitions) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on identifying individuals receiving the award, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
